name: roe_trend_reliance

name: max_profit_year_reliance
why: The headline query_financials class: max/min-year question answerable ONLY from the 12y statement history (agg=max on net_profit). Must name the fiscal year AND the rupee value from the DB; web_search_brief or fetch_fundamentals here is a routing failure.

name: revenue_cagr_compare
